blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — United States Secretary of Defense Pete Hegseth is expected to arrive in Cebu on Wednesday, Oct. 28, for a high-level gathering of defense ministers of the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean), where discussions are expected to focus on regional security, military cooperation and strengthening defense partnerships. Hegseth’s anticipated visit comes as the Philippines hosts the 20th Asean Defence Ministers’ Meeting (ADMM) and 13th ADMM-Plus in Lapu-Lapu City from Oct. 28 to 29. The meetings will bring together defense officials from the Asean and its eight dialogue partners, including the United States, China, Japan, Australia, India, New […]...
